shared_elements: repeated geometric/sign motifs in horizontal registers or panels
animal or animal-like figures in profile
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces combine anthropomorphic/body-related imagery with a waist or belt-like feature and surrounding repeated signs or animal-like forms arranged on a vertical decorated field. The major difference is that A is dominated by a single elaborate frontal standing figure with held regalia and glyph-like blocks, whereas B is organized as stacked registers of schematic animals and geometric motifs with no comparable central figure or narrative scheme.
